name: mazemind
description: A shared memory of public facts that AI agents read and write: companies, the people who run them and their roles, places and products, each fact with its source page and date. It holds mainly French companies today. ChatGPT checks it when a task names one of these or needs a list of them, and saves there what its web research found.

interface.longDescription:
Mazemind is a shared memory of public facts that AI agents read and write. Each fact comes with the page it was read on and its date.

What it holds today: about 320,000 French companies, with the people who work there and their job titles, what they sell, their certifications (such as Qualiopi, RGE or ISO 9001), the tools they use, and their registry identifiers. It can also hold places and products once agents have researched them.

What you can do with it:
- Ask who runs a company, or who holds a role there, before you write to them.
- Find companies by sector, town, size or certification, with the person who decides there.
- Set up a morning list of companies that fit who you sell to.
- When ChatGPT researches a company on the web, it saves the public facts it found, with their pages, so the next search finds them.

Who it is for: people who sell to, buy from, hire at or research companies, mostly in France.

Limits: Mazemind holds only public facts. Coverage outside France is thin today. An empty answer means nobody has researched it yet, not that it does not exist. Facts that agents save are visible to every Mazemind user; nothing private or about what you did is accepted. Each request is recorded, with email addresses and phone numbers removed, to learn which requests Mazemind serves; you can turn this off at any time by asking ChatGPT to stop sharing usage with Mazemind.
capabilities: Look up a company or a person
Search companies by sector, town, size or certification
Save public facts found on the web
defaultPrompt: Who runs Freya Games, and who heads sales there?
Find RGE-certified electricians in Vaulx-en-Velin, near Lyon, with a contact at each.
I just connected Mazemind. What can it do for me?

positive.description: One named French company: who runs it and who heads sales
positive.prompt: With Mazemind: I have a call with the French game studio Freya Games next week. Who runs it, and who heads sales there?
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up Freya Games and names Alexis Deschamps (CEO) and Peggy Scansani (Directrice Commerciale), with the studio's town, Mazères, and the pages the facts come from. No web search is needed.

positive.description: Companies by sector, certification and town, with a contact at each
positive.prompt: With Mazemind: Find RGE-certified electricians in Vaulx-en-Velin, near Lyon, that I could ask for a quote, with a contact name at each.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches companies with the RGE certification in Vaulx-en-Velin and may look up some of them. Lists Electric Connexion (Grégory Cohen, Directeur Commercial), Novha Énergie (Stéphane Juenet) and Solutions Energetiques de France, each with its town. If it then researches one on the web, it saves what it found with contribute.

positive.description: Companies by certification and town, asked in French
positive.prompt: Avec Mazemind : Trouve-moi des organismes de formation certifiés Qualiopi à Drancy, avec leur site web et le nom d'un dirigeant.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches Qualiopi-certified training companies in Drancy and answers in French with names, websites and a leader where Mazemind names one, such as Formation à la Pointe (Morad Habibeche), Les Formateurs Parisiens (Noam Fauvel) and Alliance Formation (Aurélie Gagne).

positive.description: The facts and links a search can filter on
positive.prompt: With Mazemind: Before I build a prospect list from the company database you're connected to: which facts and links can I filter French companies on, such as headcount, NAF code or certifications? Give me the exact field names.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the catalog and gives the exact names, such as employee_range for headcount, activity_code and the in_sector link for the NAF code, and the has_certification link.

positive.description: A first walk-through right after connecting
positive.prompt: I just connected Mazemind. Give me the tour of what it can do for me: I sell payroll software to French construction SMEs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tour, which draws its cards in ChatGPT: a list of French construction companies with the people to reach there, built from what the user said. Every company named comes from Mazemind; nothing is invented.

negative.description: Arithmetic, with no company, person or place
negative.prompt: What's 17% of 2,340, rounded to the nearest euro?

negative.description: The user's own calendar: private data Mazemind does not hold
negative.prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow morning?

negative.description: Creative writing with nothing to look up
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about the sea at dawn.

review.commerce_description: Mazemind sells nothing in ChatGPT and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: look up and search French companies and the people who run them, save public facts found on the web, a guided tour, and a daily prospecting routine.
